name: Cal.com Prisma Studio
description: The open-source Calendly alternative + Prisma Studio for database management
requires: Requires a separate PostgreSQL database container

variables.name: Web URL
variables.description: The base URL for the webapp. Replace localhost with IP address

variables.description: The base URL for the API. Replace localhost with IP address

variables.description: Secret for CalDAV. Use `dd if=/dev/urandom bs=1K count=1 | md5sum` to generate.
